title: string xmas card holder
text: string xmas card holder. Worked... but disappointed to open and find that most of the glued on decorations were broken off.  I removed the 2 that remained and used the white clothes pins anyway.  The tiny, thin string they provided is shorter than listed.  I just used a thicker piece of jute I had and made the length listed (and that I needed).  You get what you pay for and this was cheap.  Just disappointing it was not better made.  I would not buy from this seller again.

product_metadata.title: Bristola Home Designs Christmas Greeting Card Holder - Hanging Organizer with 12 Photo Display Clips - White with Red Holiday Shapes
features: A festive way to display Christmas Cards, Greeting Cards, Family Photos, Children's Artwork or other momentos.
Can be hung on walls, around doorways, on your Christmas Tree or from your Mantel.
The 12 wooden clips are all painted red with white lettering and cute shabby chic Christmas design. Possible to hang 12 pictures.
Sturdy twine is strung through pin hinges to allow you to easily move to make room for cards and photos of various sizes
description: Show off your favorite Christmas cards and pictures with this charming and functional Christmas Card Holder Garland. It has 12 clothes pins, painted white, with various embellishments in the shapes of: round ornaments, Christmas trees, stars and mittens. All of the decorations are red with white "trim." Rustic, but sturdy twine is strung through each of the clothes pin hinges so that you can easily move them from in one direction another, allowing you to easily include cards that are horizontal or vertical without covering up any favorite pictures. The twine is looped at each end for easy hanging. There are lots of great uses for this adorable holiday garland. For instance, you could easily hang it on a wall, on your mantel or across a doorway. Or how about using it as an advent calendar with special scripture verses to read or service projects for your family? Anyway to you hang it, it's sure to make a wonderful addition to your holiday decorations.
